historical_result.preceding_snapshot: Step 6 listed the Title input on the New Milestone page; step 7 timed out waiting for the :visible selector.

diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-6, then read-only title-input geometry at 0, 2 and 5 seconds; no field fill or milestone creation

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 原轨迹进入 GitLab 新建里程碑页面后，快照列出了 Title 输入框，但紧接着的 :visible 填写超时。相同冻结前缀下，官方 Moli 1.1.6 的输入框存在、未禁用、样式可见、页面加载完成，而输入框及父容器的布局矩形持续五秒为零；固定候选中输入框为约 809×32。可见性筛选因导航后未刷新的布局几何而排除目标；这是脏布局快照故障在新页面表单中的实例，不局限于动态菜单。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: After the original trajectory reached GitLab's New Milestone page, its snapshot listed the Title input but the following :visible fill timed out. With the same frozen prefix, official Moli 1.1.6 had the enabled input and visible computed style on a complete page, yet the input and parent rectangles stayed zero for five seconds; the fixed candidate gave the input an approximately 809×32 rectangle. Stale geometry after navigation excluded the target from visibility matching. This extends the dirty-layout-snapshot failure family beyond dynamic menus.

scope_limit: Read-only same-page 1.1.6-versus-fixed geometry evidence; no milestone created, formal 1.1.3 post-fix rerun, repeated-flake estimate, or commit-level bisect. The historical official score remains unchanged.
